acquisition method: From each full scan, the 20 most intensive ions were selected for low-energy collision induced dissociation (CID)
cleavage agent: Trypsin was diluted in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
collision energy: low-energy collision induced dissociation (CID) with 35% collision energy
enrichment method: we established a new method based on laser microdissection combined with mass spectrometry for the isolation and analysis of neuromelanin granules.
fragmentation method: selected for low-energy collision induced dissociation (CID)
instrument: coupled to an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer
ionization type: The LC system was directly coupled with a nano electrospray ionization source
labeling: which yielded a table of the spectral counts for every peptide that belonged to a protein in a sample.
